title: Algebraic Structures on Sets of Partitions
summary: Motivated by Robert Schneider's trailblazing work toward developing a unifying algebraic theory of integer partitions, we explore various binary operations on partitions to identify algebraic structures on sets of partitions. In particular, we discover that several sets of restricted partitions form abelian groups under reduced versions of concatenation, component-wise addition, and component-wise multiplication.
